label: accounting framework
definition: framework, including policies, methods, rules, and processes, used to measure, recognize, present, and disclose the information appearing in an entity's financial statements, and, from a legal ownership perspective, that is applied for accounting consolidation determination

label: contractually capable entity
definition: a unique entity that is legally or financially responsible for the performance of financial transactions, or has the legal right in its jurisdiction to enter independently into legal contracts, regardless of whether it is incorporated or constituted in some other way (e.g. trust, partnership, contractual). This excludes natural persons, but includes governmental organizations and supranationals.

label: entity legal form
definition: a classifier for a legal entity that indicates the nature of that entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective, in the jurisdiction in which it was established

label: entity legal form identifier
definition: code that denotes an entity legal form as defined in ISO 20275

label: entity legal form scheme
definition: scheme that specifies the elements of the codes for entity legal forms, such as those that are sanctioned in a given jurisdiction as defined in ISO 20725

label: LEI registered entity
definition: a legal person that has registered for and is identified by a legal entity identifier

label: legal entity identifier
definition: an organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal person as defined in ISO 17442

label: legal entity identifier scheme
definition: a scheme that specifies the elements of an unambiguous legal entity identifier (LEI) scheme to identify the legal entities relevant to any financial transaction

label: relationship period qualifier
definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the reporting period specified, such as that the date period reflects an accounting or document filing period

label: relationship qualifier
definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period, such as the accounting framework used

label: relationship record
definition: a record describing relationships between legal entities

label: relationship status
definition: a classifier that specifies the status of the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period (active or inactive)

label: calculation agent
definition: party that is responsible for determining the value of an instrument and in some cases, determines how much the parties owe one another

label: cash instrument
definition: financial instrument whose value is determined by the market and that is readily transferable (highly liquid)

label: commodity instrument
definition: financial instrument representing an ownership interest in bulk goods, such as raw materials and primary agricultural products

label: currency instrument
definition: financial instrument used for the purposes of currency trading

label: debt instrument
definition: financial instrument and credit agreement evidencing monies owed by the issuer to the holder on terms as specified

label: derivative instrument
definition: financial instrument that confers on its holders certain rights or obligations, whose value is derived from one or more underlying assets

label: entitlement
definition: financial instrument that provides the holder an interest in, or the privilege to subscribe to, or to receive specific assets under terms specified

label: equity instrument
definition: financial instrument representing an ownership interest in an entity or pool of assets

label: exempt security
definition: security that is exempt from certain regulatory rules

label: financial instrument
definition: written contract that gives rise to both a financial asset of one entity and a financial liability of another entity

label: financial instrument identifier
definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a financial instrument for some purpose and within a specified context

label: future
definition: derivative instrument that obligates the buyer to receive and the seller to deliver the assets specified at an agreed price, at some later point in time

label: issuer
definition: role of a party that makes (or proposes to make) one or more financial instruments available in some well-defined, typically formal way

label: negotiable security
definition: security that can be transferred to another party

label: non-negotiable security
definition: security that is not transferable to another party

label: option
definition: derivative instrument that grants to the holder either the privilege to purchase or the privilege to sell the assets specified at a predetermined price or formula at or within a time period in the future

label: packaged financial product
definition: financial product that acts as a container for at least one financial instrument, including other financial products, and whose value is derived from, or based on a reference asset, market measure, or investment strategy

label: promissory note
definition: debt instrument that is a written promise by one party to another that commits that party to pay a specified sum on demand or within a specified time frame under specified terms

label: redemption provision
definition: contract provision enabling the issuer (writer) to regain possession through repayment of some stipulated price

label: securities transaction
definition: transaction between two or more parties involving the exchange of commonly defined financial products

label: security
definition: financial instrument that can be bought or sold

label: spot contract
definition: financial instrument that settles for immediate delivery on a specified date

label: standardized terms
definition: contract terms that, grouped together, that are generally and consistently reused across many contracts, published by some organization, and capable of being incorporated into a contract by reference

label: underlier
definition: something that can be assigned a value in the marketplace that forms the basis for a derivative or pool-backed instrument

label: unique transaction identifier
definition: sequence of characters identifying a financial transaction uniquely whenever useful and agreed by the parties or community involved in the transaction

label: adjusted closing price
definition: amended closing price to reflect a security's value after accounting for any corporate actions, such as stock splits, dividends, and rights offerings

label: best bid
definition: highest bid price a prospective buyer is willing to pay at a particular time for a given security

label: best offer
definition: lowest price acceptable to a prospective seller for a given security at a particular point in time

label: bid ask spread
definition: difference between an offer (ask) price and a bid price

label: bid price
definition: price a prospective buyer is willing to pay

label: clean price
definition: debt instrument price that does not include accrued interest

label: closing price
definition: cash value of the last transacted price before the market closes

label: closing price determination method
definition: strategy for calculating or otherwise determining an official closing price

label: collection of security prices
definition: collection consisting of a series of prices, each of which has a specific date and time associated with it, for some security

label: composite market
definition: group of exchanges and trading venues referenced for pricing purposes

label: derived price
definition: price that stems from another source or calculation rather than being quoted or based on actual trading data

label: dirty price
definition: debt instrument price that includes accrued interest

label: high price
definition: highest price for a given security over the period specified

label: internal rate of return
definition: discount rate that results in a net present value (NPV) of zero for a series of future cash flows

label: intra day price
definition: price for a given security at some point between the opening and official closing price on an exchange

label: low price
definition: lowest value for a given security over the period specified

label: market price
definition: last reported price at which a security was sold

label: mid price
definition: arithmetic mean between bid and offer prices

label: offer price
definition: price suggested by a prospective seller at a particular time for a given security

label: official closing price
definition: price of the final trade of a security at the end of a trading day on a given exchange

label: opening price
definition: price at which something first trades at the start of a trading day

label: price analytic
definition: statistical measure involving security prices

label: price determination method
definition: strategy for calculating or otherwise establishing a price for something

label: price spread
definition: difference between two prices

label: pricing model
definition: expression used to determine a value for an instrument at a given point in time

label: rate of return
definition: net gain or loss on an investment over a specified time period, expressed as a percentage of the investment's initial cost or value as of a specific point in time

label: security price
definition: monetary price for a financial instrument at some point in time

label: trading day
definition: time span that a particular trading venue is open

label: trading session
definition: window of time within a trading day in which orders may be placed and filled

label: volume-weighted average price
definition: average price at which a given security has traded throughout a trading day, determined by multiplying each trade by its volume, adding the results, then dividing by the volume traded for the day

label: volume-weighted open price
definition: price determined by multiplying each trade by its volume, adding the results, then dividing by the volume over a certain period during the trading day (rather than over the course of the entire day)

label: yield
definition: return on the investor's capital investment

label: yield spread
definition: the spread between the yields of two items

label: agency agreement
definition: agreement that designates a party as a registered agent to represent and act on behalf of another party in some, typically legal, financial, or medical capacity

label: agent for service of process
definition: registered agent (person or organization) designated by a business entity, such as a corporation, to receive legal correspondence on behalf of the business entity in the jurisdiction in which the agent's address is located

label: basket
definition: collection of goods, services, or other things (e.g., financial contracts) that can be purchased and sold in some marketplace

label: basket constituent
definition: component of a basket

label: broker
definition: any party that acts as an intermediary between a buyer and a seller, usually charging a commission

label: broker-dealer
definition: any party in the business of buying and selling securities, operating as both a broker and a dealer, depending on the transaction

label: catalog
definition: publication including a list of products available for sale with their descriptions and possibly prices

label: contract lifecycle
definition: lifecycle of an agreement, including, but not limited to a credit agreement, financial instrument, or other formal contract, from initial stages through retirement

label: contract lifecycle event
definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of an agreement

label: contract lifecycle event occurrence
definition: actual occurrence of an event during a specific stage of a specific contract lifecycle

label: contract lifecycle occurrence
definition: realization of the lifecycle of a specific contract

label: contract lifecycle stage
definition: phase in the lifecycle of an agreement

label: contract lifecycle stage occurrence
definition: realization, from start to finish of a phase in an occurrence of a specific contract lifecycle

label: dealer
definition: any party that purchases goods or services for resale and acts on their own behalf in a transaction

label: exposure
definition: means by which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty

label: exposure bearer
definition: party subject to influence or risk arising from a specific contract, instrument, or arrangement

label: exposure situation
definition: state of affairs in which some party is subject to influence or risk arising from a specific contract, instrument, or arrangement

label: financial exposure
definition: the extent to which an individual or organization is open to risk of suffering a loss in a transaction, or with respect to some investment or set of investments, e.g., some holding; the amount one stands to lose in that transaction or investment

label: financial intermediation service
definition: any financial service in which a third party (the intermediary) matches lenders and investors with entrepreneurs and other borrowers in need of capital

label: financial product
definition: product provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies

label: financial product catalog
definition: catalog of financial products and/or services available for sale with their description and other product details

label: financial service
definition: service provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies

label: financial service provider
definition: functional entity either licensed to provide financial services to consumers and/or businesses or established by law to provide financial services, such as a central bank

label: legal agent
definition: any party that has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party

label: licensed agent
definition: any individual who is licensed to perform a legally binding function, and who has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party

label: offeree
definition: party that receives an offer from something from someone (i.e., an offerer) based on the terms of the offering

label: offering
definition: expression of interest in providing something to someone that is contingent upon acceptance, forbearance, or some other consideration, as might be desired by an offeree(s)

label: offeror
definition: party that proposes to make something available to someone (i.e., an offeree) based on the terms of the offering

label: position
definition: financial exposure resulting from owning, borrowing, shorting, or entering into a contract (e.g., derivatives)

label: product lifecycle
definition: lifecycle specific to a product or product family

label: product lifecycle event
definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of a product lifecycle

label: product lifecycle event occurrence
definition: actual occurrence of an event that happens during a specific stage of a specific product lifecycle

label: product lifecycle occurrence
definition: realization of the lifecycle of a specific product

label: product lifecycle stage
definition: phase in a product lifecycle

label: product lifecycle stage occurrence
definition: realization of a specific stage in the lifecycle of a given product

label: registered agent
definition: legal agent designated by some party to represent them and act on their behalf under a formal agency agreement

label: regulated commodity
definition: commodity under the jurisdiction of the regulatory agency, such as the Commodities Futures Trading Commission (CFTF) in the United States, which includes any commodity traded in an organized contracts market

label: settlement terms
definition: contract terms that define the commitment to and mechanism for settling one or more sides of a transaction

label: third-party agent
definition: any service provider that is licensed to perform a legally binding function and has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party

label: trade
definition: situation that realizes an agreement between parties participating in a voluntary action of buying and selling goods and services

label: trade identifier
definition: sequence of characters identifying a trade within some context

label: trade lifecycle
definition: lifecycle that defines the evolution of a trade, from initiation through settlement

label: trade lifecycle event
definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of a trade

label: trade lifecycle event occurrence
definition: realization of an event that happens during a specific stage of a specific trade lifecycle

label: trade lifecycle occurrence
definition: realization of the lifecycle for a specific trade

label: trade lifecycle stage
definition: phase in the lifecycle of a trade

label: trade lifecycle stage occurrence
definition: realization of a phase in the lifecycle of a specific trade

label: trader
definition: party that engages in the transfer of financial assets in any financial market on behalf of a client or the financial services provider

label: trading strategy
definition: approach used for buying and selling in the securities markets

label: weighted basket
definition: basket whose constituents have some relative importance with respect to one another

label: weighted basket constituent
definition: component of a basket whose relative importance with respect to other basket constituents is known

label: portfolio
definition: collection of holdings assembled and maintained as a unit for management purposes to achieve strategic objectives

label: asset
definition: something of monetary value that is owned or provides benefit to some party

label: capital surplus
definition: capital contributed in excess of the par value (stated value) of the ownership interest issued

label: digital asset
definition: asset that exists only in digital form or that is the digital representation of another asset

label: digital token
definition: digital asset which uses distributed ledger technology for its issuance, storage, exchange, record of ownership or transaction validation and is not a currency

label: digital token identifier
definition: globally unique identifier conformant with ISO 24165 for the registration of digital tokens

label: digital token registration scheme
definition: registration scheme conformant with ISO 24165 for the registration of digital token identifiers

label: digital token registry
definition: authoritative collection of records for digital tokens

label: digital token registry record
definition: record for a digital token containing the data elements specified in ISO 24165-2:2025 for the applicable digital token identifier (DTI) type

label: earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization
definition: measure of potential cash flow that excludes the effects of capital structure, taxes and non-cash expenses

label: financial asset
definition: non-physical, tangible asset whose value is derived from a contractual claim, such as bank deposits, bonds, stocks, rights, certificates, and bank balances

label: fungible token
definition: digital token capable of mutual substitution between the individual units of digital assets

label: holding
definition: owned financial interest consisting of legal or beneficial ownership of an asset or security that confers economic rights on its owner

label: income
definition: revenue received during a period of time

label: intangible asset
definition: identifiable, non-monetary asset that lacks physical substance

label: non-fungible token
definition: unique digital token that represents proof of ownership of one or more tangible and/or intangible assets with unique metadata and/or identification such that no two are identical or fungible

label: owner
definition: party that is legally recognized as having the right to possess, the privilege to use, and ability to transfer any rights or privileges associated with something, as permitted by law

label: owners' equity
definition: owners' share in a business plus operating profit

label: ownership
definition: situation in which some party holds the legal title to something (explicitly or implicitly) and has the right to transfer that title and/or possession

label: paid-in capital
definition: assets received from investors in exchange for an ownership interest

label: physical asset
definition: tangible asset that has a material form, such as property, equipment, and inventory

label: retained earnings
definition: net profits kept to accumulate in a business after dividends are paid

label: shareholders' equity
definition: equity that is manifested in the form of shares in an entity, fund or structured product

label: tangible asset
definition: asset that is a physical, measurable resource, i.e., one that takes a physical form

label: financial instrument identification scheme
definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of financial instrument identifiers

label: international securities identification number
definition: security identifier that is defined as specified in ISO 6166, Securities and related financial instruments -- International securities identification numbering system (ISIN)

label: international securities identification numbering scheme
definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a ISINs as defined in ISO 6166

label: listed security identifier
definition: security identifier issued in the public domain and referred to in listings and other relevant publications

label: national numbering agency
definition: registration authority responsible for issuing and managing National Securities Identifying Numbers for securities in accordance with the ISO 6166 standard in some jurisdiction (typically that of a country)

label: National Securities Identifying Number
definition: generic, nine-digit alpha numeric code which identifies a fungible security, assigned by a national numbering agency under the ISO 6166 standard

label: National Securities Identifying Number registry
definition: registry used by a national numbering agency to manage the financial instrument identifiers and related information that it registers

label: national numbering agency registry entry
definition: entry in a National Securities Identifying Number registry

label: national security identification scheme
definition: security identification scheme, defining the format and structure of a National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN), published nationally on behalf of a country

label: proprietary security identification scheme
definition: security identification scheme published by a commercial entity

label: proprietary security identifier
definition: identifier supplied by a commercial entity

label: security identification scheme
definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers

label: security identifier
definition: any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security

label: security registry
definition: registry used to manage security identifiers and related information

label: security registry entry
definition: record for a security in a securities registry

label: ticker symbol
definition: reassignable identifier of relatively short character string length that is unique within an exchange for a particular financial instrument or listing for that instrument
